heroTitle:
Test your device.
Know every detail.
heroDescription: {count} tools to test your screen, input devices, audio, camera, gamepad and browser. Free, with nothing to install.
unsupported: Not supported by this browser or device.
fullscreenUnavailable: Fullscreen is unavailable; you can still inspect the test area.
how1Text: Find a tool for your device or the behavior you want to investigate.
how2Text: Run a measurement, press keys or inspect patterns on your display.
how3Text: Review the results and factors that may affect the test.
privacyText: Keyboard events, mouse events and test history are processed locally, without uploading them. No advertising or third-party tracking.
faqLocalQ: Do I need to install an app?
faqLocalA: No installation or account is needed. For camera and microphone tests, use HTTPS and allow access when prompted.
faqAccuracyA: Not always. Each tool distinguishes direct observations, estimates, calculations and manual inspection. Read the limitations below the test.
faqSaveA: Only summaries are saved when you enable local saving. Keyboard and mouse logs are not saved automatically.
hiddenWarning: The tab became hidden or lost focus. Sampling stopped; retest with the tab visible.
insufficient: Not enough valid samples. Retest and keep interacting continuously.
unstable: Intervals vary substantially or include delayed frames. System load may affect this result.
copyError: Copy failed; select the result and copy it manually.
invalidInput: Enter integer dimensions from 1–100,000 and a positive diagonal up to 1,000 inches.
physicalCaveat: This estimate does not confirm native panel resolution.
manualInspection: Inspect the display yourself; there is no automatic pixel detection.
patternHint: Tap to change · ← → for patterns · Esc to exit
fullscreenError: Cannot enter fullscreen. Allow Fullscreen or use the current test area.
touchHint: Touch or use a pen inside this area
touchOnly: Only touch and pen inputs count; mouse input is not a touch test.
captureHint: Click to activate. Tab or Esc exits. System shortcuts may not reach this area.
captureActive: Capturing keys · Tab or Esc exits
buttonTestHint: Press, release or move your mouse inside this area
pollingHint: Move the mouse continuously inside the area while sampling
pollingWarning: Browser event frequency does not confirm USB Polling Rate.
saveResults: Allow up to 30 local test summaries
storageError: Local storage is unavailable. You can still use the tools.
notFoundText: This address does not exist or the tool has not been published.
errorText: An error occurred while loading. Try again or return to the tool list.
consentVisual: Color patterns can be bright. Adjust display brightness before viewing.

deviceTools.deviceLimit: Information may be rounded or hidden; it does not confirm CPU model, installed RAM or physical display resolution.
deviceTools.compatibilityLimit: Support does not guarantee a connected device or permission. This check does not open the camera or microphone.
deviceTools.detailedRenderer: Opt in to detailed renderer information
deviceTools.gpuUnavailable: Graphics information is unavailable. Check browser settings; this does not establish a faulty GPU.
deviceTools.gpuLimit: Information may be hidden or describe software rendering, rather than the physical GPU, VRAM or performance.
deviceTools.storageConsent: This test writes, reads and deletes temporary browser data. Existing data is preserved.
deviceTools.cleanupWarning: The browser blocked removal of a temporary probe key. Existing application data has not been deleted.
deviceTools.storageLimit: Capacity is an estimate for this website, not your disk. IndexedDB/CacheStorage are checked for support only, without read/write tests.
deviceTools.pointerLimit: Reported pressure and contact size may be browser defaults rather than physical measurements.
deviceTools.pointerArea: Touch, pen and mouse observation region
deviceTools.pointerActive: Move a mouse, touch or use a pen here.
deviceTools.pointerIdle: Select Start to activate this region.
deviceTools.taskInterrupted: The test stopped after losing focus, hiding the page or resizing the window. Select Start to retry.
deviceTools.movementLimit: Move inside the area for up to 60 seconds. Distance is in CSS pixels, not DPI/CPI or latency. Average speed includes idle time.
deviceTools.movementActive: Move your mouse here; leaving breaks the path.
deviceTools.accuracyLimit: Left-click 10 targets within 60 seconds. Results describe your task performance, not sensor precision.
deviceTools.mouseRequired: Use the primary mouse button for scored attempts. Keyboard, touch and pen input are not scored.
deviceTools.fullscreenLimit: Select the button to enter fullscreen. If unsupported, use the inline area. Dimensions are in CSS pixels, not physical resolution.
deviceTools.fullscreenError: Fullscreen was refused or interrupted. Use the inline region or try again from its button.
deviceTools.exitHint: Use the exit button or Esc. Your browser may provide another exit gesture.

audioTools.consent: Lower system volume, start at a low level and stop if uncomfortable. Playback ends after 10 seconds or when you leave the tab.
audioTools.range: 20–20,000 Hz, subject to browser support. Signal level is not physical loudness.
audioTools.invalid: Enter a valid frequency within the supported range. Playback is stopped for invalid settings.
audioTools.blocked: Playback was not allowed or did not start. Check browser audio settings, then select Start again.
audioTools.failed: The audio session could not run. Check the output device and browser settings, then try again.
audioTools.interrupted: Playback stopped after leaving the tab or an audio interruption. Select Start to play again.
audioTools.interpretation: If you hear nothing, check mute, volume and the selected output. Playback status alone does not confirm working speakers.

inputAudio.consent: The microphone opens only after Start and permission. Audio is processed on your device without recording or upload. Stop or leave the tab to end; maximum 60 seconds.
inputAudio.latePrompt: Allow or deny access in the permission prompt before retrying. Stop cannot close that prompt.
inputAudio.muted: The microphone is muted; readings resume when input returns.
inputAudio.spectrumDescription: Microphone frequency bands; the strongest frequency is also shown as a numeric reading.
inputAudio.waveformDescription: Input audio waveform; RMS and peak levels are also displayed as numbers.
inputAudio.noData: No live samples. Start and allow microphone access to display data.
inputAudio.frequencyAxis: Log frequency axis: 20 Hz → {max} Hz. Vertical range: −100 to −10 dBFS. Empty FFT bands remain empty.
inputAudio.waveformNote: The waveform is simplified for display; RMS and peak use the full input data.
inputAudio.interpretation: Signal levels are not physical loudness or a mic quality rating. If no signal appears, check mute, the selected input and noise-filtering settings.
inputAudio.audio-unavailable: Audio analysis is unavailable in this browser. Try another browser; the microphone has not been opened.
inputAudio.audio-blocked: Analysis could not start. Check audio settings and microphone permission, then retry.
inputAudio.analysis-failed: Audio analysis failed. Check the input device and browser settings, then retry.
inputAudio.interrupted: The test stopped after leaving the tab or an audio interruption. Select Start to retry.
inputAudio.input-ended: The input stream ended or device access was revoked. The session has stopped.
inputAudio.timeout: The 60-second limit was reached. Select Start to retry; respond to any remaining permission prompt.

cameraTools.consent: The camera opens only after Start and permission. No audio capture, recording or video upload. Stop or leave the tab to turn it off; maximum 60 seconds.
cameraTools.latePrompt: Allow or deny access in the permission prompt before retrying. Stop cannot close that prompt.
cameraTools.noData: No video. Select Start and allow camera access to preview.
cameraTools.muted: The camera is not sending frames; FPS readings resume when video returns.
cameraTools.fpsUnavailable: This browser cannot measure video FPS. The preview and reported camera settings remain available.
cameraTools.fpsMethod: At least 2 seconds of continuous video are needed to estimate FPS. A — means there are not enough valid frames.
cameraTools.interpretation: Results describe the current stream settings and FPS, not the sensor’s maximum specifications. Lighting, system load and display Refresh Rate can affect FPS.
cameraTools.playback-blocked: Video could not play within 10 seconds. The camera was released. Check browser settings and select Start again.
cameraTools.camera-ended: The camera stream ended or access was revoked. The session has stopped.
cameraTools.interrupted: The session stopped after focus loss, a hidden page or paused video. Select Start to try again.
cameraTools.timeout: The 60-second limit was reached and the camera is off. Select Start to preview again.
cameraTools.preview-failed: Video could not be read or displayed. The session stopped and released the camera.

gamepadTools.consent: Reads the controller locally without uploading data or triggering vibration. Stop or leave the tab to end and clear results; maximum 120 seconds.
gamepadTools.connect: Connect a controller and press one of its buttons while this page is active. If it is not listed, check the connection and retry.
gamepadTools.truncated: This controller has too many buttons or axes; some are not displayed.
gamepadTools.standard: For standard mapping, axes 0/1 usually represent the left stick and 2/3 the right. Labels may vary by device.
gamepadTools.unmapped: Select two different axes to view a stick; the browser has not reported a standard mapping.
gamepadTools.plotDescription: Normalized axis plot from minus one to one, with positive Y down; X/Y values are also provided as text.
gamepadTools.plotNote: The deadzone circle is a visual reference; it changes neither input data nor controller settings.
gamepadTools.neutral: Select Measure rest position, then release the stick. Allow 1 second to settle, followed by 5 seconds of observations. Do not move the controller or touch the stick during this window.
gamepadTools.driftLimits: Offsets depend on drivers and system deadzones. Results do not establish a hardware fault; a zero reading does not guarantee a perfect sensor.
gamepadTools.interpretation: Results do not measure USB Polling Rate or latency. After an interruption, select Start to retry.

capability.unknown: Controller support has not been checked.
capability.available: The browser supports controllers; press a controller button to detect yours.
capability.unsupported: Controller input is unavailable in this browser. Try another browser.
capability.insecure-context: HTTPS or a trustworthy localhost is required.

failure.interaction-required: Focus this visible page and select Start directly.
failure.blocked: Controller access was refused. Check browser settings and retry.
failure.read-failed: The controller could not be read. Check the connection and driver, then retry.
failure.disconnected: The controller disconnected or is no longer detected. Reconnect it and select Start.
failure.device-changed: The device or button layout changed. Select Start for a new test.
failure.interrupted: The session stopped after focus loss, a hidden page or navigation. Select Start to continue.
failure.timeout: The 120-second limit was reached. The session stopped and cleared data.

driftPhase.settling: Allowing 1 second to settle; release the stick.
driftPhase.completed: Window complete; read the results before Stop or Reset.
driftPhase.invalid: Insufficient continuous valid data. Results were cleared; try again with this page focused.

problems.title: What is happening with your device?
problems.description: Choose the symptom you notice to find a useful test.
problems.note: These tools help inspect symptoms; they do not diagnose hardware faults.

screen.title: Screen feels choppy
screen.description: Sample browser frame timing and look for motion ghosting.

keyboard.title: Keys keep repeating
keyboard.description: Watch for unexpected repeated presses and check how each key responds.

microphone.title: Microphone is not working
microphone.description: Check the input signal after granting microphone access, then explore its audio spectrum.

keyboardTools.layoutProgress: Received {tested}/{total} key codes in this layout
keyboardTools.layoutNote: An unmarked key is not necessarily faulty; input methods and system shortcuts may intercept events.
keyboardTools.outsideLayout: Received codes outside the selected diagram
keyboardTools.localNote: Captures keys only in the activated test area; key data is not uploaded or saved automatically.
keyboardTools.unidentified: {count} events with an unidentified key/code stopped capture.
keyboardTools.composing: {count} events with an IME signal stopped capture.
keyboardTools.codeLimit: This session reached 256 key codes; new codes appear only in the log. Reset to begin a new session.
keyboardTools.rolloverNote: Keeps the largest combination until Reset. Received key counts do not certify NKRO/6KRO.
keyboardTools.flagsNote: Browser-reported flags do not establish LED state or a hardware source. isTrusted does not certify physical input.
keyboardTools.chatterNote: Auto-repeat is separate; totals persist until Reset. Threshold: 1–500 ms. A short gap does not prove a faulty switch.
keyboardTools.logWindow: Keeping {retained}/200 recent events; {total} events received. Clearing the log keeps statistics.
keyboardTools.diagramHint: Scroll horizontally to view the full diagram. Tab/Esc stops capture; when inactive, use arrow keys to scroll. Test with real keys.
keyboardTools.inputHelp: Switch UniKey/EVKey to E or select English (ENG) for press/hold measurements. Vietnamese input methods can replace text and generate Backspace.

inputIssue.composition: An input method interfered. Results from this activation were discarded to avoid miscounts; earlier results remain.
inputIssue.unavailable: A key code could not be identified. Results from this activation were discarded; earlier results remain.

keyboardTools.inputRecovery: This does not establish a keyboard fault. Switch to E/ENG and select Activate test area to retry.

doubleD.note: Note: dd → đ in Telex. The input method can intercept D or generate Backspace, so automatic dd detection may be incomplete.
doubleD.title: Check your input method when testing D repeatedly
doubleD.standard: Vietnamese Telex can turn dd into đ and generate Backspace; this does not establish a faulty keyboard. Switch to E/ENG for press/hold measurements, or enable EVKey compatibility for A–Z recognition only. Changing modes clears the session.
doubleD.compatibility: Telex can turn dd into đ and generate Backspace. This mode recognizes A–Z via keyup only; it does not assess Backspace or measure presses, hold, rollover or Key Chatter. Two D releases do not establish two physical presses.

release.note: Recognizes A–Z on release only; no press counts, hold, rollover or Key Chatter. Changing modes stops capture and clears the session.
release.help: Keep EVKey in Vietnamese Telex mode to test letters. ↑ means a release was received, not that a complete press was verified.
release.progress: Received {tested}/{total} letter key codes via keyup
release.scope: Tests A–Z only; Backspace, numbers and other keys are not assessed. An unreceived key is not necessarily faulty.
release.result: Received {count} distinct letter key codes; this is not a press count.
release.interference: An input-method signal or unidentified code appeared. Waiting for valid A–Z releases; intervening events are not counted.

preferences.title: Preferences on your device
preferences.body: Theme, language and saving preferences stay in your browser. Delete data below removes only Device Lab data.

measurements.title: Keys, mouse and history
measurements.body: Key, mouse and controller data are not sent to the server. Summaries are saved only when you enable saving and select Save; they do not contain key contents or mouse logs.

media.title: Microphone and camera
media.body: Access starts only after you select Start and grant permission. Audio and video are processed on your device without recording or upload. Select Stop or leave the page to turn the device off.
